about.title: About DomainesMajd
about.subtitle: Morocco's Premier Avocado Producer
about.intro: Founded in 2010, DomainesMajd combines traditional Moroccan farming wisdom with modern sustainable practices to produce the finest avocados in the region.
about.description: Located in the fertile region of Souss-Massa, our orchards benefit from Morocco's unique climate and rich soil, producing avocados with exceptional flavor and texture that are in high demand across European and global markets.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Starting with just 50 hectares in the fertile Atlas foothills, we've grown to become Morocco's leading avocado exporter, serving premium markets worldwide.
history.foundationText: DomainesMajd was founded with a vision to produce premium avocados while respecting traditional Moroccan agricultural practices and implementing sustainable farming methods. Starting with just 50 hectares in the foothills of the Atlas Mountains.
history.exportsText: After establishing consistent quality production, we began exporting to European markets, quickly gaining a reputation for exceptional avocados that combined quality with sustainable growing practices. Our first shipments to France and Spain marked the beginning of our global journey.
history.certificationText: We achieved organic certification and GlobalG.A.P. status, validating our commitment to environmentally friendly practices. We expanded our orchards to 200 hectares and diversified our avocado varieties to include Hass, Fuerte, and Bacon.
history.innovationText: We invested in state-of-the-art packing and cold chain technology, allowing us to extend our reach to markets in Asia and the Middle East. Our commitment to innovation led to improved water conservation techniques that reduced our water usage by 60%.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To deliver exceptional quality Moroccan avocados while honoring sustainable practices, supporting local communities, and preserving our natural resources.

values.title: Our Values
values.qualityText: We never compromise on quality, ensuring every avocado that leaves our farm meets our exacting standards.
values.sustainabilityText: We are committed to environmental stewardship, implementing water conservation, soil health, and biodiversity protection practices.
values.integrityText: We build long-term relationships based on trust, transparency, and consistent delivery on our promises.
values.communityText: We invest in our local communities, providing fair wages, healthcare support, and educational opportunities.

team.title: Our Leadership
team.description: Our experienced team combines traditional agricultural wisdom with modern expertise to produce the finest avocados Morocco has to offer.
team.ceoDescription: With over 25 years of agricultural experience, Hassan combines traditional farming wisdom with innovative practices.
team.operationsDescription: Laila ensures our avocados reach global markets in perfect condition while managing our logistics network.
team.agriculturalDescription: Omar leads our sustainable farming initiatives, specializing in water conservation and soil management.

products.title: Our Premium Avocados
products.intro: We specialize in growing and exporting the finest Moroccan avocados, carefully cultivated in our orchards and delivered to markets worldwide.

hass.name: Hass Avocado
hass.description: Our flagship variety, known for its rich, creamy texture and nutty flavor. Perfect for guacamole and direct consumption.

fuerte.name: Fuerte Avocado
fuerte.description: Smooth, green skin with pale green flesh. Slightly lighter flavor than Hass with a higher oil content.

bacon.name: Bacon Avocado
bacon.description: Thin, dark green skin with light-colored flesh. Milder flavor and lower oil content than Hass.

sustainability.title: Our Commitment to Sustainability
sustainability.intro: Sustainability isn't just a practice at DomainesMajd — it's our promise to the environment, our communities, and future generations.

waterManagement.title: Water Management
waterManagement.content: Our drip irrigation systems reduce water usage by 60% compared to traditional methods, while collecting rainwater helps us minimize our environmental footprint.

soilHealth.title: Soil Health
soilHealth.content: We utilize organic compost and natural fertilizers to maintain soil vitality without harmful chemicals, promoting biodiversity and long-term productivity.

biodiversity.title: Biodiversity Preservation
biodiversity.content: Our orchards integrate native plants and trees, creating natural habitats for beneficial insects and birds that help with natural pest control.

socialResponsibility.title: Social Responsibility
socialResponsibility.content: We provide fair wages, healthcare, and education support for our workers and their families, investing in the communities that help us grow.

goals.title: Our Sustainability Goals
goals.intro: We're committed to ambitious environmental and social goals that drive our operations towards a more sustainable future.

waterNeutral.title: Water Neutral by 2025
waterNeutral.content: Implementing advanced irrigation systems and water recycling to achieve water neutrality in our operations.

carbonNegative.title: Carbon Negative by 2030
carbonNegative.content: Investing in renewable energy and carbon capture technologies to exceed carbon neutrality.

zeroWaste.title: Zero Waste Operations
zeroWaste.content: Implementing comprehensive recycling and composting programs to eliminate waste from our facilities.

community.title: Community Development
community.content: Expanding our educational and healthcare initiatives to support more local families.

certifications.intro: Our commitment to sustainability is validated by internationally recognized certifications.
